meta.title: Sessions board
meta.description: Replaces the sidebar's workspace browser with a live agentbar-style board: three sections (Needs you, Running, Recent), one compact row per Session with a status glyph, its title, and how long ago it changed. The glyph separates shapes as well as colors — ? for a pending interaction, a pulsing dot while work runs, ✓ for a finished turn, · for idle — so the state does not depend on color alone. Selecting a row opens that Session; the collapsed rail keeps one dot per active state. Rows come from the Session list and live status the page already holds, so nothing is read from disk and no model request is made. Enabling it hides the shipped workspace browser, including its search, drag reordering, and Add-workspace controls.
